# Official test data

Run `python tools/fetch_fixtures.py` from the repository root after installing the package.
The original PDFs/ICS files are downloaded directly from Stadtwerke Bergheim and ignored by Git.
`areas-2027.json` lists the official PDF links for all thirteen calendar areas.
It also covers the revised Glessen PDF whose December day numbers are omitted.
They are not covered by the source-code MIT license and are not redistributed in this repository.
